# small-things.vaked.dev

> The south wall of the music: a minute of small things, thinking the
> music in the background. Bella and Blue, the spoon, the power nap, the
> cleanse cry, the small testament on beat sixty.

Source: https://github.com/8b-is/small-things.vaked.dev
Live: https://small-things-vaked-dev.pages.dev

## What it is

- A warm, slow page: one small thing per beat (7.2s), sixty beats to the
  minute, seeded shuffle, then the small testament plays.
- The music-thought layer: reads the newest row of the ultrawhale dogfood
  bucket's music feed and glows with the current track - and stays honest
  when it cannot (the music is thinking, in the background).
- No dependencies, one file, the pure engine isolated in `#st-core` for
  the corridor.

## Key data

- THINGS: the named small things (from the shelf, and the quiet universal
  ones), the comma among them
- TESTAMENT: the small testament, human-to-machine, on the sixtieth beat
- BEATS_PER_MINUTE: 60

## Doctrinal notes

The minute owns the wall, the machines own the record, the ledger rows
the tears but never purges them. Small things, appreciated, since the
beginning. Corridor: `./e2e.sh` (selftest + robots + this file).
